name: vwap_overshoot_fade_002
author: claude_strategist
mechanism: On NIFTY, a 0.6%+ deviation from session VWAP (~135 spot points at 22500) crosses a threshold that activates two structural reversion forces absent at shallower levels: options market makers who accumulated long delta exposure from selling calls/puts during the move begin systematic gamma-hedging rebalances — their risk models flag 0.6%+ index deviations as outliers requiring immediate adjustment. Simultaneously, risk-parity and VWAP-indexed institutional programs that tolerate minor (0.3%) misalignments hit their rebalancing band and begin aggressive accumulation, creating sustained demand/supply flow back toward VWAP. The Bollinger band filter (20-minute ±2σ envelope, 240 bars at 5s) ensures the index has NOT broken out of its intraday stochastic range — price inside the envelope means the overshoot is likely a transient inventory imbalance, not a regime change. RSI(36) exhaustion below 20 (3-minute window, matching original RSI(3) on 1-min) confirms the 5-second directional momentum driving the overshoot has fully burned out before structural buyers arrive.

indicators.name: vwap_session
indicators.formula: VWAP(close, volume) from session open, resets each day
indicators.purpose: Cumulative VWAP from session open — no lookback needed, always cumulative. At 0.6%+ deviation, NIFTY's VWAP-benchmarked institutional algos and gamma-hedging market makers both face significant model violations that force directional rebalancing. The 0.6% threshold (vs 0.3% in v001) selects for deeper, rarer dislocations where the reversion force is larger and more persistent.

indicators.name: rsi_36
indicators.purpose: RSI(36) = 36 × 5s = 3 minutes — exact mapping of RSI(3) on 1-minute bars from the original (3 × 1-min = 3 min). This is NOT a 12x scaling; it preserves the same 3-minute exhaustion window. The 3-minute RSI detecting <20 or >80 means the micro-momentum of the overshoot has been sustained long enough to exhaustall short-term sellers/buyers, but not so long that a new equilibrium is forming.

indicators.name: adx_36
indicators.purpose: ADX(36) = 3-minute trend strength. Threshold <22 ensures no active institutional TWAP/VWAP directional execution is underway — if a large order is working, VWAP deviation will persist and deepen rather than revert. Compressed from original ADX(14) on 1-min (14 minutes) to 3 minutes to match our 30-120s hold horizon: we need the regime of the NEXT 2 minutes, not the regime of the last 14 minutes.

indicators.name: bb_upper_240
indicators.purpose: Bollinger upper band on 20-minute window (240 × 5s = 20 min) — matches original BB(20) on 1-min bars (20 × 1 min = 20 min). This is a CONTEXT filter (not a trade trigger), and the 20-minute window captures the current intraday volatility regime rather than a short-term fluctuation. The buy_pe filter 'close < bb_upper' ensures we're not shorting into a genuine momentum breakout above the 20-min envelope.

indicators.name: bb_lower_240
indicators.purpose: Bollinger lower band on same 20-minute window. The buy_ce filter 'close > bb_lower' confirms the deep VWAP undershoot hasn't simultaneously breached the lower 2-sigma envelope — if both conditions are true simultaneously, the move is categorically different (sustained panic, not transient overshoot). When NIFTY is both 0.6% below VWAP AND below the 20-min lower BB, it suggests either a news event or systematic deleveraging: skip it.

conditions: vwap_dev < -0.006 (NIFTY >= 0.6% below session VWAP, ~135 pts at 22500)
rsi_36 < 20.0 (3-minute RSI: short-term selling momentum fully exhausted)
adx_36 < 22.0 (3-minute tape is range-bound: no active directional institutional flow)
close > bb_lower_240 (inside 20-min lower BB: overshoot hasn't become a volatility breakout)
buy_ce.confirmation: All four conditions simultaneously during early session (09:25-11:15)

conditions: vwap_dev > 0.006 (NIFTY >= 0.6% above session VWAP, ~135 pts at 22500)
rsi_36 > 80.0 (3-minute RSI: short-term buying momentum fully exhausted)
adx_36 < 22.0 (3-minute tape is range-bound: no active directional institutional flow)
close < bb_upper_240 (inside 20-min upper BB: overshoot hasn't become a volatility breakout)
buy_pe.confirmation: All four conditions simultaneously during early session (09:25-11:15)

exit.stop_rationale: 5 option points = ~10 NIFTY spot points of further adverse extension. At a 0.6% VWAP deviation entry, another 10 spot points away (to 0.6%+ 0.04%) indicates the structural reversion thesis is failing: neither gamma-hedging nor VWAP-indexed accumulation is dominating. At the 30-120s horizon, NIFTY's typical move is 2-10 option pts; a 5pt adverse move clearly exceeds 'normal noise' and signals the deviation is being driven by a sustained one-sided order, not a transient imbalance.
exit.target_rationale: 8 option points ≈ 16 NIFTY spot points from entry. A 0.6% VWAP deviation (~135 pts) with structural reversion forces active should snap back at least 10-15% of the total deviation (13-20 spot pts). Capturing 16 spot points (8 option pts at delta ~0.5) is the conservative 12% reversion target — well within what gamma-hedging and VWAP-benchmarked accumulation achieve in the first 60-90 seconds. For NIFTY at 1-2 minute horizons, typical option moves are 3-10 pts; 8 pts targets the upper end (1:1.6 R:R), appropriate for a deeper-deviation setup with stronger reversion force.

filters.vix_filter: none — at 0.6% VWAP deviation depth, the reversion is structural (gamma + VWAP benchmarking), not regime-dependent; VIX doesn't differentiate these deep-overshoot conditions
filters.time_filter: 09:25-11:15 IST only — opening inventory correction window; before 09:25 pre-open noise creates false VWAP deviations; after 11:15 the market has had 2 hours to find direction and 0.6% deviations from VWAP more likely reflect genuine trends
filters.volume_filter: implicit — high-deviation bars typically have elevated volume; RSI(36) exhaustion acts as a surrogate volume filter by requiring a sustained 3-minute directional move
filters.trend_filter: adx_36 < 22 — active 3-minute trend disqualifies; additionally, bb_lower/upper filter removes cases where the move has structure beyond intraday noise
filters.spread_filter: none — limit order execution at candle close prices

edge.edge_decay_risk: low — structural (gamma-hedging + VWAP benchmarking are persistent institutional behaviors); but signal is rare (1-3 trades/day) so sample accumulation is slow

adaptation_notes: Four changes from the original equity strategy: (1) VWAP threshold INCREASED from 0.5-0.6% on individual stocks to 0.6% on the NIFTY index — at first this seems like no change, but individual FnO stocks deviate more easily; 0.6% on NIFTY is a rare, forceful event whereas 0.6% on an individual stock is more routine. The threshold was kept at 0.6% but the selectivity is much higher on the index. (2) RSI(3) on 1-min → RSI(36) on 5s: exact same 3-minute window preserved, not 12x scaling. (3) ADX(14) on 1-min → ADX(36) on 5s: COMPRESSED from 14-min to 3-min matching hold horizon. (4) Relative volume (rel_volume_20) removed — index volume is incomparable bar-to-bar; replaced conceptually by the RSI exhaustion requirement (a genuine 3-minute overshoot will naturally have higher volume). Bollinger bands KEPT as a 20-minute context filter (BB(240)=same 20-min window as BB(20) on 1-min), but purpose changed: not 'price is inside BB so it must revert' but rather 'price has NOT broken the 20-min volatility envelope, confirming the overshoot is a transient imbalance and not a breakout'. The index_return_15 filter (index must be flat) was removed — we ARE the index, and ADX(36) serves the same function of ensuring no directional trend is active.
weaknesses: Signal is rare (1-3 per session) — only fires on deep 0.6%+ VWAP deviations with simultaneous RSI(36) exhaustion and range-bound ADX, limiting daily PnL accumulation
RSI(36) at 5s resolution can be spiked by a single large candle in the 3-minute window, producing a false exhaustion reading without genuine momentum depletion
On high-VIX days when NIFTY legitimately moves 0.6% in minutes, the ADX filter may lag the regime change by 30-60 seconds, allowing some trend entries disguised as mean reversion
